question: Where was the headquarters of the Dev Samaj located?
solution:
The correct answer is **Lahore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dev Samaj** was founded by Shiv Narayan Agnihotri in 1887.
 
• The organization aimed to reform society by promoting **ethical living** and **spiritual development**.
 
• **Lahore** served as the headquarters of Dev Samaj until the partition of India in 1947.
 
• Dev Samaj has been instrumental in **educational reforms**, establishing several schools and colleges.
 
• The organization also focused on **women's empowerment** and **social justice**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Dev Samaj** is a religious and social reform organization in India.

It was founded by **Shiv Narayan Agnihotri** in 1887.

The organization aims to promote **ethical living** and **spiritual development** among its followers.

Dev Samaj has been active in **educational reforms** and has established several schools and colleges.

The organization also focuses on **women's empowerment** and **social justice**.
